WITH account_counts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.customer_id, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
  FROM Accounts AS a
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.customer_id
), town_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, account_id, transaction_count,
         SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS town_transaction_count
  FROM account_counts
), town_shares AS (
  SELECT tc.account_id, tc.customer_id, tc.transaction_count,
         tc.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(tc.town_transaction_count, 0) AS town_transaction_share
  FROM town_counts AS tc
), ranked AS (
  SELECT ts.account_id, c.town_city, ts.transaction_count, ts.town_transaction_share,
         ts.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(ts.transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_average
  FROM town_shares AS ts
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = ts.customer_id
)
SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, town_transaction_share, ratio_to_average
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10
